predicate.label: departed from
predicate.definition: Person, group or organization X physically leaves or withdraws from geographic place Y.
excludes: leaving a job or team as an institution without geography
predicate.scope_notes: Includes: leave/withdraw/pull out from Y; historical physical departure. Excludes: arrival/return to Y; residence alone; leaving a job or team as an institution without geography. Ambiguous unless resolved by case-local evidence: place versus institution as source; explicitly conditional departure.

rationale: Driven/expelled-out and withdrawal-from form the leading departure family; invading a territory is distinct and not itself departure.
